frozen_at_phase: 3 (post-modeling, PRE-calibration — no Phase 4/5 result existed when this was written)
purpose: Pre-registered analysis plan for the one-shot Phase 7 holdout ceremony. The ceremony script computes EXACTLY these outputs, in this order, once, and nothing else. Adding, removing, or reordering analyses after Phase 4/5 results exist would reintroduce the garden of forking paths this plan exists to close.

inputs.model: constrained-and-recalibrated 5-fold LightGBM ensemble (Phase 5 output) — NOT the unconstrained Phase 3 ensemble
inputs.calibrator: isotonic fit on the CONSTRAINED ensemble's OOF (Phase 5 recalibration)
inputs.cost_parameters: the frozen Phase 4c constants exactly as written in the spec — LGD {cash 0.70, rev 0.85}, EAD factors {cash 0.85, rev 1.00}, r_net 5%, m_rev 0.18, term formula with config/term_fallback_rule.json
inputs.data: the 61,503-row holdout, touched by this script only
inputs.cost_accounting: config/cost_evaluation_convention.json — realized-outcome profit ledger; best-flat selected on dev OOF and frozen; savings = Δprofit per 10k applications

outputs_in_order: 1. Holdout AUC of the deployed ensemble (compare against OOF 0.777x — playbook step 5: large disagreement means CV leaked)
2. Holdout Brier + ECE + reliability diagram (10 quantile bins) of calibrated probabilities; compare against climatology 0.0736
3. Instance-dependent policy cost vs BEST-FLAT policy cost on holdout (the honest gap, reported whatever its size, narrative already locked at the Phase 4c OOF checkpoint)
4. Instance-dependent policy vs naive 0.5 threshold: EUR savings per 10,000 applications with the illustrative-assumptions qualifier (the headline)
5. Sensitivity table over the frozen grids (LGD +/-0.10, r_net 3-8%, EAD per spec) — recompute 3 and 4 per grid point
6. Profit vs approval-rate curve + swap-set 2x2 table vs the 0.5 baseline
7. Fairness at deployed decisions: disparate impact ratio, |dFPR|, |dFNR|, t*(x) distribution by gender (audit frame), against the Phase 5b pre-registered expectations
8. Scorecard holdout AUC (one line, for the honest model comparison)
rules: The script runs once. Re-runs after code fixes are permitted ONLY if no result of a prior run influenced the fix, and every run is logged in the ceremony output.
No metric outside this list is computed on holdout labels.
Numbers quoted anywhere as RESULTS come from this run; all OOF numbers remain labeled as development estimates.

enforcement_added_at_phase7_design_revie.preflight_gate: label-free validation (contract types, NaN cost params, AMT_CREDIT) runs BEFORE any TARGET is read; aborts rather than silently rejecting every applicant
enforcement_added_at_phase7_design_revie.run_once_guard: refuses to overwrite an existing ceremony result without --force; every invocation appended to ceremony_run_log.jsonl
enforcement_added_at_phase7_design_revie.consistency_check: the ceremony itself reports whether AUC and gap fall inside the pre-registered bands from holdout_power_analysis.json; outside = a FINDING to investigate, never a number to accept quietly

preregistered_bands.basis: 2000 bootstraps of dev per-row ledger differences resampled at n=61,503 (dev data only, before the ceremony)

enforcement_added_at_phase7_design_revie.holdout_feature_side_preflight_results: contract types clean (2 known values), zero NaN cost params, 2 rows use the frozen term fallback, zero unseen categories, max NaN-rate difference vs dev 0.0035 — validated on FEATURES only; no label was read
